messages:
Maya CSM: Hey all — prepping the SLA playback for GoodLeaf ahead of their renewal review next Tue. Need to align on uptime window, latency SLOs, and a proposed credit calculation.
Omar (Success Ops): Thanks Maya. Quick Q: do we have finalized uptime numbers for the past 90 days? I grabbed a quick chart but want the canonical CSV.
Priya (TPM): I exported the metrics yesterday from Console -> Reports -> Uptime. I can drop the CSV here in a minute. It includes daily uptime, p50/p95/p99 latency per route.
Kevin Eng: FYI the p99 spike on 2026-11-03 was traced to a backend config roll that lasted ~12m — SLO breach window logic flagged it. We have the rollback notes in the incident ticket.
Maya CSM: Good to know. For the customer-facing doc I'd like: 1) actual uptime % over the billing period, 2) p95/p99 latency against SLOs, 3) incident summary, 4) credit calc example. Keep wording simple.
Omar (Success Ops): Draft credit calc proposal: if uptime < SLA_target then credit = prorated_percent * monthly_commit, where prorated_percent = min( (SLA_target - actual_uptime) / SLA_target_cap, 1 ). Suggest SLA_target = 99.9, SLA_target_cap = 0.5 (so max 50% of monthly commit). Thoughts?
Priya (TPM): That seems conservative. Customer previously expected linear credit up to 100% — need to check contract language. Also we should show a worked example.
Maya CSM: Please include a worked example. Something like:
```
SLA target: 99.9%
Actual uptime: 99.55%
Delta: 0.35%
Cap used: 0.35 / 0.5 = 0.7 -> 70% of cap
Monthly commit: $12,000
Credit: 0.7 * (0.5 * $12,000) = $4,200
```
Maya CSM: We'll present that as illustrative only, referencing the exact contract clause.
Kevin Eng: I'll add a short tech note about the rollback and mitigations (auto-fallback to smaller model pool + KV cache hot-warm warming) so they see we have controls.
Omar (Success Ops): Also recommend including latency SLO table — p95 target 200ms, p99 target 800ms. For GoodLeaf their p99 for inference route was 920ms on the incident day. That aligns to the uptime/quality narrative.
Priya (TPM): Uploading CSV and a pared-down PPT slide with graphs now. Link: https://redwood.s3/gs/goodleaf-sla-playback-1872345678.csv
console-bot: File uploaded: goodleaf-sla-playback-1872345678.csv (size: 1.2MB)
Maya CSM: Perfect — next steps: Omar to draft the one-pager with credit calc and incident summary, Kevin to add the technical mitigation blurb, Priya to attach the CSV and slides. I'll run a dry-run with the AE on Monday.
Omar (Success Ops): Assigned. I'll post a draft before EOD Fri for review.
Priya (TPM): Done uploading slides.
Kevin Eng: Will add the tech note + links to incident ticket by EOD.
Maya CSM: Thanks team. If we stick to the short examples and one clear credit calculation, we should keep the renewal conversation focused. :thumbsup:
Omar (Success Ops): Also flagging renewal risk: usage dropped 18% month-over-month and they tried a competitor POC. I'll annotate the playbook with suggested enablement touchpoints (workshop, async eval kit).
Maya CSM: Add that as an appendix to the SLA playback — helps combine health + contractual context.
Priya (TPM): Noted. I'll include a one-slide appendix with enablement timeline and next steps.
Maya CSM: Great. Ending thread — will post final doc link here once consolidated.
Omar (Success Ops): Thanks everyone.
